falsifier: Reject the family before risk selection if the no-control reference and registered core search cannot produce positive aggregate net Sharpe, positive net return in at least four of six chronological folds, positive pooled next-day score information coefficient, and positive score information coefficient in at least four folds. Risk overlays cannot rescue that failure. Also reject or formally pivot if the otherwise identical raw-momentum ablation has a higher declared selection metric than the selected BTC-residual signal.
thesis: Gradual capital rotation creates persistent cross-sectional repricing after the common BTC move is removed. A path-efficient medium-horizon residual drift should continue over the next daily holding interval, while subtracting recent actual funding pressure avoids the expensive crowded side. A bounded causal BTC-trend tilt changes sleeve budgets without eliminating either side.
